title.cn: 首次离京：购票像一门选修课
title.en: First Leave Beijing: Ticketing as Elective Course

text.cn: 你第一次在中国做城际移动。12306 / 航司 App、实名制、证件核验……进站口像一道毕业考。这趟「交通事件」只会发生一次——之后你就「熟了」，熟到开始嫌别人排队慢。
text.en: Your first intercity move in China. 12306 / airline apps, real-name tickets, ID checks… the gate feels like a final exam. This transit event happens once — then you’re “experienced,” experienced enough to judge other people’s queues.

text.cn: 用国内号顺利收到验证码，线上取票进站。
text.en: Local number gets the SMS; e-ticket and enter smoothly.

lockedHint.cn: 需要国内手机号——漫游选手请改走窗口人生。
lockedHint.en: Needs a local Chinese number — roamers, enjoy counter life.

feedback.cn: 进站像本地人。你第一次觉得 Tutorial 办的卡没有白办——它终于开始付房租。
feedback.en: You enter like a local. That Tutorial SIM finally pays rent.

text.cn: 窗口人工购票 / 用护照反复尝试取票机。
text.en: Buy at the counter / wrestle the passport ticket machine.

feedback.cn: 护照号码少输入一位，排队重来。你学会了「仔细核对每一个字母」——以及如何用微笑掩饰崩溃。
feedback.en: One missing passport digit — queue again. You learn to check every letter, and to smile through internal collapse.

text.cn: 花小钱找「黄牛式」协助（不推荐，但慌的时候很香）。
text.en: Pay a little for “helpful” middlemen (not advised; panic makes it tempting).

feedback.cn: 票是买到了，心里留下一点「我不该这样」的余韵——像吃了过期的便利店寿司。
feedback.en: You got the ticket — and a lingering “I shouldn’t have,” like expired convenience-store sushi.

text.cn: 车厢/机舱里，手机掉进红色电量。隔壁旅客热心递来一份连不上的公共 Wi‑Fi 密码，像一份善意的空头支票。
text.en: Aboard, your phone hits red. A neighbor kindly shares a public Wi‑Fi password that doesn’t work — a friendly rubber check.

text.cn: 掏出行动电源续命（或车站买一个天价的）。
text.en: Deploy a power bank (or buy an overpriced station one).

feedback.cn: 电量回升。你决定以后把「电」当成第四种生存资源——排在空气之后、尊严之前。
feedback.en: Battery rises. You decide power is survival resource #4 — after air, before dignity.

text.cn: 关掉屏幕睡觉/发呆，抵达再说。
text.en: Screen off. Sleep/zone out. Deal on arrival.

feedback.cn: 你抵达时像一颗没电的土豆，但至少没有在路上当场裂开。
feedback.en: You arrive like an unplugged potato — but you didn’t crack en route.

text.cn: 首次城际移动的「学费」缴完了。以后再出发，不会再触发这段教学事件——但时间与金钱照样会扣，而且更不讲情面。
text.en: Tuition for your first intercity move is paid. This tutorial transit won’t repeat — money and time still will, with less mercy.
